acceptanceCriteria: The actual WI-240 audit reason `await reviewed merge and exact branch/worktree cleanup` is accepted when all existing repository, Contract, evidence, Runtime, PR, base, head, resourceContext, and blocked-unmerged bindings are valid.
Empty or whitespace-only reason text is rejected as invalid_premerge_finalize, and a foreign receipt remains rejected even with nonempty audit text.

Lifecycle state awaiting_merge_close derives from typed result disposition=blocked, failureCodes=[unmerged_pull_request], unknownCodes=[], and after branch=present/worktree=clean/pullRequest=unmerged; reason text is never interpreted as a lifecycle token.
English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese WI-188 governance policy and reference parity describe the corrected reason boundary consistently.
goal: Runtime-valid pre-merge finalization receipt with arbitrary nonempty audit reason passes the hosted gate while empty/whitespace or foreign receipts still fail closed.
intent: 修正治理完整性门禁与 Runtime v0.2.31 finalization receipt 的 reason 语义不一致：reason 是非空可审计文本，awaiting_merge_close 状态由 typed blocked/unmerged result 推导，不依赖未文档化 token。
outOfScope: All WI-240 and WI-242 archive, evidence, decision, Contract, Summary, and Outcome bytes

scenarioCoverage.expected: A Runtime v0.2.31 pre-merge receipt using the exact WI-240 nonempty audit reason is classified as awaiting_merge_close when every typed identity and state binding is valid.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the governance integrity fixture with the literal WI-240 reason and assert a passing report whose lifecycleState is awaiting_merge_close.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Empty and whitespace-only reason values fail closed as invalid_premerge_finalize.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the empty and whitespace fixture cases and assert deterministic invalid_premerge_finalize findings.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A foreign repository receipt remains invalid even when it supplies the same nonempty auditable reason text.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the foreign pre-merge fixture with the WI-240 reason and assert invalid_premerge_finalize.

scenarioCoverage.expected: English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese policy text consistently separates audit reason prose from typed lifecycle state.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run documentation acceptance, parity status, and the strict governance gate.
